resources.string: CheapTrip is a unique search engine that finds the cheapest ways between cities, combining flights, buses, trains and ferries.
Matter Of Choice presents interactive scenarios to help you learn decision-making skills.

On-device AI: your chat model now answers in every mini-app next to the cloud models (questions without a photo), and in a new on-device Chat (menu). Everything runs on your phone.
One Models screen for chat and translation models: search and filters, which model answers chat and which translates, and a check that shows whether a model really works on this phone.
Settings → On-device AI turns the mini-app answers on or off.
